title: 第一卷 第5章 三品武者第一卷 第6章 修炼之道
lines: 赵凇抬起头，对于陈玄，他还是有些不屑。
“什么钱？”赵凇一副无所谓的表情问道。
事实上，作为整个将军府的总厨，赵凇在将军府，是有些地位在的。
虽然陈玄白浅浅的贴身婢女亲自过来打招呼，但是他依然不认为陈玄能够对自己造成什么威胁，甚至他对陈玄的杀心，更加的重了。
“赵总厨，我再提醒你一下，二夫人非常欣赏陈玄！”小红开口道：“如果你抢了陈玄的钱，我劝你最好还给他，不然我回去给二夫人说清楚情况，恐怕二夫人就会亲自过来了！”
赵凇听到这话，他的神色一沉，而后在怀里摸索了一下，将两锭纹银取了出来！
不过他的一双眸子，却死死的盯着陈玄，那眼神之中的威胁，毫不掩饰。
陈玄根本不理他的威胁，他直接把纹银给拿了过来。
“陈玄，我再给你细说一下夫人的饮食时间！”小红道。
“好！”陈玄将银子给收了起来，
两人回到了陈玄住的那个堆积着杂物的屋子，刚刚走入，小红的眉头就皱了皱道：“你就住在这里？”
“这里挺好的，最起码有个自己的房间，收拾收拾，就还不错了！”陈玄笑着说道。
在原主的记忆之中，其他的人，都是几个人睡一个大通铺，这里虽然环境差了一点儿，但是好在有自己的私密空间。
小红点头道：“好吧，我给你说一下，二夫人每日用膳的时间分别是辰时，午时，戌时用餐，你在这个时间之前，要将吃食备好，然后送往夫人的院子里！”
“好！”陈玄笑着说道：“刚才还多谢小红姑娘解围！”
“你我都是二夫人的人，我自然要帮衬一下，但是陈玄，我得提醒你一下你，赵凇肯定不会善罢甘休的，你住在这后厨，还得自己小心一些！”小红说道。
“赵凇在将军府地位很高吗？”陈玄问道。
事实上，即便是原主也不清楚，毕竟在原主的记忆之中，他接触的都是后厨的人！
小红点头道：“将军府的下人之中，男子皆是当年玄甲军退下来的，这赵凇，曾经便是玄甲军的伙夫，自身也是一名三品武者，他在将军府，还是能够说得上几句话的。”小红道：“虽然我刚才提醒了两句，说你是二夫人的人，他应该不敢在明面上对你如何，但是从他那眼神来看，他一定不会放过你的！”
陈玄自然也明白！
一来，自己忤逆了他。
二来，自己展现出的厨艺，会让他感觉到紧迫，自己只露了一手，便让二夫人选为私人厨子。
如果其他的主子也看上了自己的手艺，那么他在将军府的地位，就岌岌可危了。
“谢谢小红姐姐了！”陈玄说道。
小红冲着陈玄笑了笑道：“对了，下次你给二夫人做饭的时候，可以单独也给我做点儿吗？刚才我闻起来挺香的。”
“小问题！”陈玄笑了笑。
小红的脸上露出了喜色，然后她连忙道：“那我就先回去咯，对了，你现在有钱了，最好也去购买一本简单的功法锻炼一下自己，不然…你的身体会吃不消的！”
说完，她红着脸就从杂物房跑了出去！

Zhao Song raised his head, he was still a little disdainful of Chen Xuan.
"What money?" Zhao Song asked with an indifferent expression.
In fact, as the chief chef of the entire General's Mansion, Zhao Song has some status in the General's Mansion.
Although Chen Xuan's personal maid Bai Qianqian came to say hello in person, he still didn't think Chen Xuan could pose any threat to him, and his murderous intention towards Chen Xuan became even more serious.
"Chef Zhao, let me remind you again, the Second Madam appreciates Chen Xuan very much!" Xiao Hong said: "If you robbed Chen Xuan of his money, I advise you to return it to him. Otherwise, if I go back and explain the situation to the Second Madam, I am afraid the Second Madam will come here in person!"
When Zhao Song heard this, his expression darkened, then he groped around in his arms and took out two ingots of patterned silver!
However, his eyes were fixed on Chen Xuan, and the threat in his eyes was undisguised.
Chen Xuan ignored his threat and took the silver directly.
"Chen Xuan, let me tell you more about Madam's eating time!" Xiao Hong said.
"Okay!" Chen Xuan collected the money and said
The two returned to the house filled with debris where Chen Xuan lived. As soon as they walked in, Xiao Hong frowned and said, "You live here?"
"It's pretty good here. At least I have my own room and can tidy up, so that's pretty good!" Chen Xuan said with a smile.
In the memory of the original owner, the other people all slept in a big bunkhouse. Although the environment here was a little worse, fortunately, they had their own private space.
Xiaohong nodded and said: "Okay, let me tell you, the second lady's daily meal times are Chen hour, noon hour, and Xu hour. You must prepare the food before this time and send it to the madam's yard!"
"Okay!" Chen Xuan said with a smile: "I just thanked Miss Xiaohong for the rescue!"
"Both you and I belong to the Second Madam, so naturally I have to help, but Chen Xuan, I have to remind you that Zhao Song will definitely not give up. You live in the back kitchen, so you have to be careful!" Xiao Hong said.
"Does Zhao Song have a high status in the General's Mansion?" Chen Xuan asked.
In fact, even the original owner didn't know. After all, in the original owner's memory, all the people he came into contact with were people in the kitchen!
Xiaohong nodded and said: "Among the servants in the General's Mansion, all the men were those who retired from the Xuanjia Army. This Zhao Song was once a cook of the Xuanjia Army, and he is also a third-level warrior. He can still speak a few words in the General's Mansion." Xiaohong said: "Although I just reminded you that you are the second lady, he should not dare to do anything to you in public, but judging from his eyes, he will definitely not let you go!"
Of course Chen Xuan also understands!
First, I disobeyed him.
Secondly, the cooking skills he showed would make him feel the urgency. He only showed his skills and let the second lady choose him as his personal cook.
If other masters also take a fancy to his craftsmanship, then his position in the General's Mansion will be in jeopardy.
"Thank you, Sister Xiaohong!" Chen Xuan said.
Xiao Hong smiled at Chen Xuan and said, "By the way, next time you cook for the Second Madam, can you cook something for me alone? I smelled delicious just now."
"Small problem!" Chen Xuan smiled.
Xiao Hong's face showed joy, and then she quickly said: "Then I will go back first. By the way, now that you have money, you'd better buy a simple exercise book to exercise yourself, otherwise... your body will not be able to bear it!"
After saying that, she blushed and ran out of the utility room!
